scope: Generic persistent hash maps and sets with explicit key policies

validation.packageExample: collections/example, installed sources using kit/ import alias, expected [12,15,1]
validation.isolation: HEAD archive plus collection changes; concurrent ECS, pages, point-grid, lookup and performance_storage edits excluded. Collection sources, fixtures, example and native benchmark/test code match the live checkout.

limitations: All timed workloads include fixture construction, guest invocation and result decoding; not isolated operation latency.
Sequential workload timings, not paired map/array samples. Includes an earlier confirmation run to show observed timing variation.
Initial run used ordinary warmup/sampling for the linear reference; final run marks it expensive and uses 3 warmups, 5 samples and 4 replay checks.
Committed guest memory is arena capacity, not live collection size or host RSS.
Full-hash collisions use linear buckets; building an all-colliding collection is quadratic.
The default hashes are deterministic, not cryptographic; caller key equality and hashing must agree.
No gdev integration or game frame-time measurement.
Benchmark dependency inventories cover watched source roots and include concurrent unrelated sources; collection imports do not depend on those changes.
